Toll‐like receptor (TLR)9 is expressed in the lung in a variety of cells, including bronchial epithelial cells, alveolar macrophaes, vascular endothelum and alveolar septa.

Toll‐like receptor (TLR)9 mRNA and protein is expressed in bronchial and alveolar epithelial cells, vascular endothelum, alveolar macro‐ and septal cells and in alveolar macro­phages in human and mouse lungs, and that the numbers of TLR‐9 expressing cells are increased in human COPD lungs compared to normal lungs.

TLR9 mRNA expression was detected in bronchial and alveolar epithelial cells, vascular endothelum, alveolar macrophaages and other lung cells, in both mouse and human lungs; and TLR9 protein expression was detected in the same cell types.
